Sprig Nganga
CR 8

A sprig nganga is a tiny, humanoid figure no taller than a foot. Its shimmering purple skin seems to catch and reflect the dappled sunlight filtering through the canopy. A wild mane of multicolored, feather-like hair dances with each slight movement of its head.

XP 4,800
Sprig Nganga 9
N Tiny humanoid (sprig)
Init +3; Senses low-light vision; Perception +14

DEFENSE

AC 21, touch 15, flat-footed 18 (+3 Dex, +2 size, +4 armor, +2 shield)
hp 63 (9d8+18)
Fort +5, Ref +6, Will +12 ; +2 vs. death effects & negative energy effect

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft.
Melee quarterstaff +6/+1 (1d4-2/x2)
Space 2-1/2 ft.; Reach 0 ft.
Special Attacks Growth Surge (9 rounds/day)
Spells Known (CL 9th; concentration +14)

4th (3/day)—cure critical wounds, death ward, freedom of movement
3rd (5/day)—cure serious wounds, dispel magic, remove curse, speak with dead
2nd (6/day)—bear’s endurance, delay poison, lesser restoration, remove paralysis, spiritual weapon
1st (6/day)—bless, cure light wounds, divine favor, protection from evil, sanctuary
0th (at will)—create water, detect magic, guidance, light, mending, purify food and drink, read magic, resistance, stabilize, virtue

STATISTICS

Str 6, Dex 16, Con 12, Int 10, Wis 20, Cha 14
Base Atk +6; CMB +2, CMD 15
Feats Extra Beasty, Spiritual Resilience, Toughness, Weapon Finesse
Skills Craft (Nkisi) +12, Heal +17, Knowledge (arcana) +12, Knowledge (nature) +12, Knowledge (religion) +12, Perception +14, Spellcraft +12, Survival +14
Languages Common, Sylvan
SQ Ancestral Guidance (3/day), Healing Ritual (cure serious wounds 1/day), Nkisi Creation (3 nkisi), Spirit Sight (12 rounds/day), Spirit Ward (1/day)
Gear +1 mithral shirt, +1 darkwood heavy wooden shield, quarterstaff, cloak of resistance +1, headband of inspired wisdom +2, ring of protection +1, wand of cure moderate wounds (25 charges), potion of invisibility (2), various ritual components and herbs worth 500 gp Tree-father Mwangi is the venerated leader of his Sprig tribe, a role evident in every aspect of his diminutive yet commanding presence. Standing just shy of a foot tall, his shimmering purple skin is etched with intricate patterns that seem to pulse with an inner light, reflecting his deep connection to the spiritual realm.

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Growth Surge (Su)

When witnessing a death, a sprig nganga can grow to Medium size for 9 rounds as a free action. While in this form, gains +2 Str, +2 natural armor, and 1d4 claw damage.

Healing Touch (Sp)

A sprig nganga can use cure light wounds or stabilize once per day as a spell-like ability. It has three nkisi: Nkisi of Life, Nkisi of Protection, and Nkisi of the Ancestors.

Nkisi of Life: A sprig nganga can cast cure light wounds a number of times per day equal to Wisdom modifier (5).

Spirit Form (Su)

A sprig nganga can become incorporeal for 4 rounds/day.

ECOLOGY

Environment tropical forest
Organization tribe (20-60 Sprigs)
Treasure Standard

A sprig nganga wears elaborate robes woven from the finest forest materials, each thread imbued with protective enchantments and spiritual significance. Around his neck hangs the Nkisi of Life, a small, intricately woven reed doll that holds the power to create new Sprigs. He moves with a grace that conceals his advanced years, each gesture precise and purposeful. When he speaks, his voice carries the weight of ancient forests and the whispers of countless ancestors, commanding respect from beings many times his size. In times of great need, he can invoke his Growth Surge, temporarily growing to the size of a human and taking on a more bestial appearance, his once- tiny form now a formidable protector of his people and the natural world.

A sprig nganga can be charged into a fully adult Sprig through an 8-hour ritual using 500 gp worth of materials.
